high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express" website. The top section of the screen shows the website's logo and navigation options, including a menu icon on the left and a user profile icon on the right. The main content of the article discusses a situation involving the immersion of ashes in the Yamuna River. The text mentions that someone was asked to return in the morning to take the ashes for immersion, but by then, people from the area and the police had arrived. When the fire was doused, the body was found half-burnt, according to the statement provided.
